about: Questions on pillarjs/router at target.json's commit. A reply is right when its CITATION path is one of `paths`, the cited line (in the pinned checkout) contains one of `expect`, and every regex in `answer` matches the ANSWER text (case-insensitive). `line` is the canonical line; `node scripts/check.ts` verifies it against the checkout. The position (start, middle, end) comes from where that line sits in the packed prompt.

questions.q: On what cron schedule does the OpenSSF Scorecard GitHub workflow run?
According to the changelog, which router release fixed hanging on a large stack of sync routes?
expect: Fix hanging on large stack of sync routes

Which exact version of mocha does package.json list in devDependencies?
